report.query:
SELECT
  id,
  total
FROM orders
WHERE
  customer_id = 42
ORDER BY
  id
LIMIT 50
report.diagnosis: Seq Scan on orders and subsequent Sort are caused by lack of an index that can both filter on customer_id and provide the required ordering by id. This forces a full table scan, filtering, then sorting before applying the LIMIT.

candidates.name: idx_orders_customer_id_id
candidates.hypothesis: An index on (customer_id, id) lets PostgreSQL use an Index Scan that directly satisfies the WHERE clause and the ORDER BY, eliminating the Seq Scan and Sort nodes.
candidates.query: SELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 42 ORDER BY id LIMIT 50
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer_id_id ON orders (customer_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_pkey ON public.orders USING btree (id)
